name: Hotel Good Luck Palace
address: Amer Road, Near Ramgarh Mode, Govindpuri Plot No.121, 302016 Jaipur, India
description: Comfortable Accommodations: Hotel Good Luck Palace in Jaipur offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and free WiFi. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and free toiletries. Dining Options: Guests can enjoy a terrace restaurant serving buffet, a la carte, halal, and Asian breakfasts. The on-site restaurant provides a variety of dining experiences. Convenient Facilities: The hotel features a terrace, balcony with mountain and city views, free private parking, and a paid airport shuttle service. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, room service, and a tour desk. Nearby Attractions: Jalmahal is a 12-minute walk away, while Jantar Mantar and City Palace are 3.5 km from the property. Other attractions include Amber Fort and Jaigarh Fort, each 6 km distant. Jaipur International Airport is 16 km away.

name: Hotel Amar International
address: 2024, Street No.7, Chitra Gupta Road, Near R.K. Ashram Metro Station, Chuna Mandi, Paharganj, 110055 New Delhi, India
description: Comfortable Accommodations: Hotel Amar International in New Delhi offers spacious family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and soundproofing. Each room includes a TV, electric kettle, and free toiletries. Essential Facilities: Guests enjoy free WiFi, a paid shuttle service, lift, 24-hour front desk, housekeeping, room service, car hire, and a tour desk. Additional amenities include a fireplace, hairdryer, and minibar. Prime Location: Located 15 km from Delhi International Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as Gurudwara Bangla Sahib and Jantar Mantar, each 3 km away. Other points of interest include Red Fort and India Gate within 6 km. Guest Satisfaction: Guests appreciate the attentive staff, room cleanliness, and spacious rooms.
